hero.description: Art History graduate transitioned into Frontend Development. I build web interfaces and mobile apps combining aesthetic sensitivity, code logic, and UI design.

about.title: About Me
about.text: I am a frontend developer with a background in Art History — that intersection between <1>visual analysis and code logic</1> is what I enjoy most about my work. I program with <3>React and TypeScript</3>, and I also design in Figma, taking interfaces from sketch to functional code.
about.pillar1Desc: Aesthetic sensitivity and visual precision applied to component design.
about.pillar2Desc: Modular web development, type safety, and interactive animations.
about.pillar3Desc: Experience in mobile apps (Capacitor/Firebase) and real client websites (WordPress).
about.pillar4Desc: Seamless bridge between design teams and frontend technical development.

secretBarcelona.title: Secret Barcelona
features: Conducted a complete redesign of the website in Figma and developed custom WordPress components for this travel agency. Developed an interactive map plugin using AI and custom HTML/CSS widgets, along with implementing SEO optimizations. Following my internship, the company retained me for paid freelance collaboration.

erova.title: Erova
features: Developed a cross-platform digital closet app (iOS/Android) with React and Capacitor. Integrated Firestore for real-time data management, Cloudinary for image optimization, and Google Generative AI API to generate personalized outfit suggestions.
erova.status: Active functional prototype; cloud APIs and AI usage limited to control consumption costs.

planeo.title: Planeo
features: Handled the frontend development for the project's public pages. Built a responsive interface using React and Tailwind CSS, implementing complex animations and interactions with GSAP and Framer Motion to enhance UX while integrating with the backend team.
planeo.status: Bootcamp project deployed and live as a demo.
